comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: I think you guys are right. Which has me worried – what if all my comics have been two panels too long? It was seriously a last minute decision. I’ll have to watch out for this in the future.

comments.author: Erick
comments.text: Dont panic dude, your comics seem to have just the right amount of punch and beat to it. Go with your gut imo.

comments.author: Everybody
comments.text:
I liked this punchline the best.
Mostly because when I read the comic I thought ” what about teacher?”.
But I liked having 2 punchlines in 1 comic the best.

Who told you, that you only can have 1 punch line in every comic ?
Look at this comic: http://www.amazingsuperpowers.com/
One punch line in the comic you see.
Click at the invisible question sign at top right at the strip, and you’ll find a secret panel/strip with a second punch line.
Now go back and hover your mouse over the first strip and you get a third punch line.
